evidence.screenshotScope: One native sign-in screen showing the four provider entries and an unauthorized redirect URI error; four failures are user-reported, not four independent agent traces.

authentication.cause: The selected Clerk instance rejects the community application's native redirect URI before provider authentication.
authentication.requires: Keeping the old community redirect requires instance administrator allowlisting. The requested version11 repair instead explicitly passes the existing official OAuth callback while retaining the community package and unchanged authentication verification.
authentication.nextAcceptance: Build version11 and test each provider's sign-in, callback, cancellation, account preservation and T3 Connect access, including coexistence with the official app. Pre-provider HTTP200 responses are not successful callback tests.
authentication.email: Historical real email login and account retention through version10 passed; this issue does not establish a new email-login test.

repairV11.google: Prefer browser OAuth in community UI; do not reuse official package/signature Google One Tap configuration

serverPreflight.scope: Anonymous native sign-in creation only; no provider account login or completed callback

repairV11.officialAppCoexistence: unverified; Android may route the shared callback to either installed app or a chooser

localization.component: Clerk Android UI 1.4.1 native error snackbar
localization.cause: AuthStateEffects uses state.message directly when present; Android string resource overrides only localize its fallback message.
localization.requiredPresentation: Show a localized explanation of the rejected callback while preserving the actual URI and original diagnostic details. English mode must retain English explanatory text.
localization.suggestedChineseExplanation: 登录回调地址未获当前登录服务授权，请联系服务管理员。你可以先使用邮箱登录。
localization.constraints: Do not translate network response fields, alter authentication decisions, impersonate the official package, or silently replace the Clerk instance.
